
# **Tipping Study - pt.1 load & refactor data**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{R}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(gsignal)
```

#### Data

```{R}
factors_from_path <- function(path) {
  block_factors <- unlist(strsplit(dirname(path), split = "/"))
  trial_factors <- unlist(strsplit(basename(path), split = "_"))
  block <- unlist(strsplit(block_factors[3], split = "_"))

  list(
    participant = block_factors[1],
    block_num = block[2],
    hand_used = block[3],
    side_used = block[4],
    trial_num = trial_factors[2],
    target_loc = trial_factors[4],
    distractor_loc = trial_factors[6]
  )
}

fread_markup <- function(path) {
  dt <- fread(here::here("data", "raw", "opti", path))
  design <- factors_from_path(path)
  dt[, "_io" := NULL] # don't know what this is or why it's there
  dt[, names(design) := design]
}


files <- list.files(
  path = here::here("data", "raw", "opti"),
  recursive = TRUE
)

dt <- files[!grepl("practice", files)] |>
  lapply(fread_markup) |>
  rbindlist()
```

Refactor
---

#### Type conversion

```{R}
numerics <- c(
  "pos_x", "pos_y", "pos_z",
  "frame_number"
)

factors <- c(
  "hand_used", "side_used",
  "target_loc", "distractor_loc",
  "participant", "trial_num", "block_num"
)

convert_columns <- function(dt, numerics, factors) {
  dt[, (numerics) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = numerics]
  dt[, (factors) := lapply(.SD, as.factor), .SDcols = factors]
}

convert_columns(dt, numerics, factors)
```

#### Spread markers

Originally long, with markers separated by row (5 / frame)

```{R}
marker_count <- 10
dt[, marker_id := rep_len(1:marker_count, .N)]

dt <- dcast(dt, ... ~ marker_id, value.var = c("pos_x", "pos_y", "pos_z"))

new_labels <- c()
for (p in c("x", "y", "z")) {
  for (i in 1:marker_count) {
    new_labels <- c(new_labels, paste0("m", i, "_", p))
  }
}

setnames(dt, 9:ncol(dt), new_labels)
```

#### Rescale data from meters to millimeters

Before anyone gets too excited, no, Optitrack cannot report to 17 decimals.
For scale, a proton's radius is ~0.8^-15 meters.

```{R}
to_rescale <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt))

dt[,
  (to_rescale) := lapply(.SD, \(col) round(col * 100, digits = 0)),
  .SDcols = to_rescale
]
```

#### Make frames relative & add time column

```{R}
dt[, frame := seq_len(.N), by = .(participant, trial_num, block_num)]
dt[, time := frame / 120]
```
